lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in four semi-parallel horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a staggered grid-like formation.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a localized rectangular grid pattern on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting high luminance on the superior edge transitioning to a sharp shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A cluster of approximately 8-12 small, discrete high-luminance spots distributed across the leading edge and lateral surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two commensal fish (likely remoras) exhibiting high-contrast silhouettes located ventrally to the primary pectoral fin.
